optimizedDescription.value: GetArtifactInstruction returns schema instruction, rules, template, and delta guidance for one change artifact.

optimizedContext.value:
# GetArtifactInstruction

## Rules

- Constructor: `ChangeRepository`, `ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository>`, `SchemaProvider`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`, `TemplateExpander`, `LifecycleEngine`.
- `expand()` on `instruction`, `template`, `deltaInstruction`, and `rules` text before return. Parsers supply delta format + outlines; specs read existing files; lifecycle auto-selects when `artifactId` omitted.
- Input: `name` required; `artifactId` optional. Omitted → `LifecycleEngine.nextArtifact`: first in `schema.artifactDag().topologicalOrder()` whose deps are effectively `complete` or `skipped` and itself is not. All done → `ArtifactNotFoundError`.
- Missing change → `ChangeNotFoundError`. `schema.name()` vs `change.schemaName` mismatch → `SchemaMismatchError`. Unknown artifact id → `ArtifactNotFoundError`.
- Template vars only `change.name` and `change.path` via `ChangeRepository.changePath()`. MUST NOT inject `change.workspace` or primary workspace (`workspaces[0]`, default).
- Resolve independently, declaration order:
  - `rulesPre`: `rules.pre` texts; else `[]`
  - `instruction`: schema field or `null`
  - `template`: read schema-dir file via `SchemaRegistry`, expand same vars; no template → `null`
  - `delta` when `delta: true`: `formatInstructions` = `parsers.get(artifact.format).deltaInstructions()`; `domainInstructions` = `deltaInstruction` or `null`; `availableOutlines` = `string[]` of `change.specIds` whose artifact file exists in `SpecRepository`. MUST NOT embed outline trees; full content via `GetSpecOutline` / `specd specs outline <specPath> --artifact <artifactId>`. `delta: false` → `delta: null`
  - `rulesPost`: `rules.post` texts; else `[]`
- Result: `artifactId`, `rulesPre`, `instruction`, `template`, `delta` (`formatInstructions`, `domainInstructions`, `availableOutlines`), `rulesPost`. Scratch work uses rules+instruction+template; deltas use rules+`delta` and fetch outlines on demand.
- Factory `createGetArtifactInstruction(config, options?)` → `resolveGetArtifactInstructionDeps(resolver)` → canonical deps form. Resolver: `changes`, `specs`, `schemaProvider`, `parsers`, `templates`, `lifecycle`. No inline fs wiring.

## Constraints

- Read-only: no change mutation, no commands.
- `rules.pre` / `rules.post` augment instruction; they do not replace it.
- Does not evaluate step availability or artifact status.
- Missing spec artifact files skipped silently when building `availableOutlines`.
- Full outline trees excluded; consumers call `GetSpecOutline` / `specd specs outline`.
- Unregistered artifact format → `ParserNotRegisteredError`.
